# FluidLiteArk
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/arks/FluidLiteArk.sol)

**Inherits:**
[ArkWithWithdrawalRequest](../ark-with-withdrawal-request.md)

**Title:**
FluidLiteArk

Ark contract for managing ETH/WETH through FluidLite's vault via eth wrapper

Implements strategy for depositing/withdrawing ETH/WETH through FluidLite, which requires unwrapping WETH to ETH


## State Variables
### wrapper
The Eth Wrapper used for depositing into the vault


```solidity
IEthVaultWrapperV2 public immutable wrapper
```


### vault
The ERC4626-compliant vault this Ark interacts with


```solidity
IERC4626 public immutable vault
```


### weth
WETH token address used for wrapping/unwrapping ETH


```solidity
IWETH public immutable weth
```


### steth
StETH token address used for wrapping/unwrapping ETH


```solidity
ISteth public immutable steth
```


### withdrawalQueue
The withdrawal queue used for requesting withdrawals


```solidity
IWithdrawalQueue public immutable withdrawalQueue
```


### WITHDRAWAL_FEE

```solidity
uint256 constant WITHDRAWAL_FEE = 5
```


### withdrawalRequestId
The request id for the withdrawal


```solidity
uint256 public withdrawalRequestId
```


## Functions
### constructor

Constructor to set up the FluidLiteArk


```solidity
constructor(
    address _wrapper,
    address _vault,
    address _weth,
    address _steth,
    address _withdrawalQueue,
    ArkParams memory _params
)
    ArkWithWithdrawalRequest(_params, 15);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_wrapper`|`address`|Address of the FluidLite wrapper|
|`_vault`|`address`|Address of the vault|
|`_weth`|`address`|Address of the WETH token|
|`_steth`|`address`|Address of the StETH token|
|`_withdrawalQueue`|`address`|Address of the withdrawal queue|
|`_params`|`ArkParams`|ArkParams struct containing necessary parameters for Ark initialization|


### totalAssets

Returns the total assets managed by this Ark in the vault


```solidity
function totalAssets() public view override(Ark, IArk) returns (uint256 assets);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`assets`|`uint256`|The total balance of underlying assets in the vault|


### assetsInWithdrawalQueue

Returns the assets in the withdrawal queue.


```solidity
function assetsInWithdrawalQueue() public view returns (uint256);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|assets The amount of underlying assets currently pending withdrawal.|


### _withdrawableTotalAssets

Internal function to get the total assets that are withdrawable

FluidLiteArk stores value in shares of the vault plus any WETH held directly


```solidity
function _withdrawableTotalAssets() internal view override returns (uint256 withdrawableAssets);
```

### _board

Deposits WETH into the vault through the router

Unwraps WETH to ETH first, then deposits via the router


```solidity

```

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of WETH to deposit|
|`<none>`|`bytes`||


|----|----|-----------|

### requestWithdrawal

Requests a withdrawal of underlying assets from the Ark.

This function is only callable by the keeper.


```solidity

```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of underlying asset to request a withdrawal for.|


### withdrawUsingSwap

Withdraws assets from the Ark using a swap

### claimWithdrawal

Claims a previously requested withdrawal of underlying assets from the Ark.

```solidity

```

### isWithdrawalClaimRequired

Returns whether a withdrawal claim is required for this Ark.

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|

|`<none>`|`bool`|required Whether a withdrawal claim is required.|


### _harvest

Internal function for harvesting rewards

This function is a no-op as FluidLite vaults automatically accrue interest


```solidity
function _harvest(bytes calldata)
    internal
    pure
    override
    returns (address[] memory rewardTokens, uint256[] memory rewardAmounts);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bytes`||

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`rewardTokens`|`address[]`|Empty array as there are no separately harvestable rewards|
|`rewardAmounts`|`uint256[]`|Empty array as there are no separately harvestable rewards|
